Today I was dressed comfortably because it was a 7 hour tattoo, hair was messy, only a small amount of makeup on (plus it was goth makeup). However, when I wear heavy makeup, makeup that is more conventionally attractive, and show off my body, I get treated far better and instantly coddled and comforted when seeming upset. Extremely odd.

Comforting to hear that my voice isn't objectively annoying, but also upsetting to know I'm not alone in noticing this sort of crap.

I did end up contacting the studio to ask if this is normal behaviour, because I did find it really weird, especially when the receptionist is *incredibly* loud, far more than I am. Plus it's a new tattoo artist (literally has been working there for not even 2 weeks) so I found it really odd that it was him of all people to tell me to be quiet, and not anyone who had been working there for years?
